name: gen_sea_poem
task: User dictates a short poem with a title, with live formatting and one quick edit.

turns.say: Heading tide notes, okay, I'm dictating a short poem, keep it clean and spaced.
New paragraph. I walk the pier at six thirty, um, counting gulls like loose change.
The water says, pay attention, no wait, make that, the water says, be gentle.
New paragraph. On May fifth, twenty twenty four, I promised to call my brother.
Change brother to sister. I did not, and the tide kept the receipt: twelve dollars.
Make that a list. First, salt on my lips. Second, a bell buoy singing. Third, one blue cup.
New paragraph. Scratch that, not the cup line, scratch the word blue; make it plain.
New paragraph. End with a couplet: if morning can forgive, so can I; if not, I'll learn.

judge.criteria: Document should have a heading/title, poem lines with paragraph breaks, convert spoken date/number/price to figures (e.g., 6:30, 2024, $12), apply the requested word change (sister not brother), and include a 3-item list; commands and disfluencies should not appear.
